datasets.name: AccStateData
datasets.sql:
select
  arc.DATDATE as ArchiveDate,
  arc.ACC_ID as AccID,
  abs(arc.OSTAT) as Amount,
  abs(arc.POK_OSTAT) as LAmount,
  abs(arc.OBR_D) as DebitTurnover,
  abs(arc.POK_OBR_D) as DebitLTurnover,
  abs(arc.OBR_K) as CreditTurnover,
  abs(arc.POK_OBR_K) as CreditLTurnover
from archost arc
where arc.acc_id = :AccID
order by arc.datdate desc

datasets.name: CreditTransactionsData
datasets.sql:
select
  p.ID,
  p.kredit as CreditAccID,
  p.dat as OperationDate,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.ammount_c as CreditAmount,
  p.lammount as LAmount,
  ad.acc_no as DebitAccNo,
  p.NAME as Destination
from
  provarch p,
  account ad
where
  (p.kredit = :CreditAccID)
  and (p.dat between :StartDate and :EndDate)
  and (ad.id = p.debt)
order by p.dat

datasets.name: DebitTransactionsData
datasets.sql:
select
  p.ID,
  p.debt as DebitAccID,
  p.dat as OperationDate,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.ammount_c as CreditAmount,
  p.lammount as LAmount,
  ac.acc_no as CreditAccNo,
  p.NAME as Destination
from
  provarch p,
  account ac
where
  (p.dat between :StartDate and :EndDate)
  and (p.debt = :DebitAccID)
  and (ac.id = p.kredit)
order by p.dat

datasets.name: AccountsData
datasets.sql:
select
  acc.ID as AccID,
  acc.ACC_NO as AccNo,
  acc.NAME as AccName,
  acc.OPEN_DAT as OpenDate,
  acc.CLOSE_DAT as CloseDate,
  acc.VAL_ACC as CurrencyID,
  acc.bal_cn1 as SAcc,
  acc.bal_cn2 as SAcc2,
  acc.bal_cn3 as SAcc3,
  acc.bal_cn4 as SAcc4,
  acc.KLI_ID as CustomerID,
  acc.PAIR_ACC as PairAcc,
  acc.Limit as AccLimit,
  acc.SIM_OTCET as ReportSymbol,
  acc.tipacc as AccFlags , 
  acc.FILIAL as FilialID,
  acc.Insider as Insider,
  t.OSTAT as Amount,
  t.POK_OSTAT as LAmount,
  t.OBR_D as DebitTurnover,
  t.OBR_K as CreditTurnover,
  t.POK_OBR_D as DebitLTurnover,
  t.POK_OBR_K as CreditLTurnover,
  Currency.VAL_NAME as CurrencySName,
  dsb.OSTAT as DayStartAmount,
  dsb.POK_OSTAT as DayStartLAmount,
  dlb.OSTAT as DelayedAmount,
  dlb.POK_OSTAT as DelayedLAmount,
  acc.sid#,
  acc.rowid
from
  ACCOUNT acc,
  TENOSTAT t,
  AVALUTE Currency,
  TEMPOST dsb,
  LAZYREST dlb
where
  (t.ACC_ID = acc.ID)
  and (Currency.VALUTE = acc.VAL_ACC)
  and (dsb.ACC_ID = acc.ID)
  and (dlb.ACC_ID = acc.ID)
